name: KIWI NETWORKS Villa Vicente Guerrero
summary: Declared country MX matches real country (Mexico), but subnational field 'Tabasco' is contradicted by all public sources: Inflect lists the only KIWI NETWORKS facility at '32 Puebla Norte, Villa Vicente Guerrero' and colo.exchange/DataCenterJournal record facility KWN-IXP-MXN-PUE in Puebla, Puebla state. Source for the Tabasco entry was an aggregator listing only (inflect.com Tabasco page). Not a country-level mislocation; subnational should be Puebla.
